paragraphs.text: Upon closer examination, he noticed that a common green mold had contaminated a petri dish of Staphylococcus bacteria.
In 1928, Scottish bacteriologist Alexander Fleming made an accidental discovery that would revolutionize modern medicine.
This life-saving substance was later named penicillin, opening the antibiotic era.
Returning from a two-week family vacation, he inspected his cluttered laboratory benches at St. Mary's Hospital in London.

deepFeedback.independentSentence: Kalimat B adalah 'Independent Sentence' (Kalimat Mandiri). Kalimat ini memperkenalkan waktu ('In 1928'), nama lengkap tokoh ('Alexander Fleming'), dan topik umum ('accidental discovery'). Tidak ada kata ganti (he, it, this).
pairingClues: Pasangan 1 (B ➔ D): Kalimat B memperkenalkan kepulangan/penelitian Fleming, dilanjutkan D yang menjelaskan tindakan spesifiknya ('Returning from a vacation, he inspected his lab benches').
Pasangan 2 (D ➔ A): Setelah memeriksa meja lab (D), Fleming melihat ada jamur yang mengkontaminasi cawan petri ('Upon closer examination, he noticed a green mold' di A).
Pasangan 3 (A ➔ C): Jamur penghambat bakteri di kalimat A dirujuk oleh frasa demonstratif 'This life-saving substance' di kalimat C sebagai kesimpulan penamaan penisilin.

paragraphs.text: Initially, traditional postal networks struggled to cope with the unprecedented influx of individual parcels.
As a result, modern consumers now routinely receive online orders within twenty-four hours of payment.
Over the past two decades, global retail commerce has experienced a profound shift from brick-and-mortar storefronts to digital shopping platforms.
To address these logistical bottlenecks, logistics corporations invested billions of dollars in automated fulfillment warehouses.

deepFeedback.independentSentence: Kalimat C adalah kalimat pembuka mandiri yang memperkenalkan topik besar pergeseran toko fisik ke e-commerce.
pairingClues: Pasangan 1 (C ➔ A): Pergeseran belanja online (C) menimbulkan masalah awal pada jaringan pos (A: 'Initially, traditional postal networks struggled...').
Pasangan 2 (A ➔ D): Masalah kemacetan pengiriman di A dirujuk secara langsung oleh kalimat D ('To address these logistical bottlenecks, corporations invested...').
Pasangan 3 (D ➔ B): Investasi gudang otomatis di D menghasilkan pengiriman kilat 24 jam di kalimat B ('As a result, modern consumers now receive orders within 24 hours').

items.title: The Discovery of Australia's Great Barrier Reef

paragraphs.text: In June 1770, Captain James Cook sailed the HMS Endeavour along the uncharted eastern coastline of Australia, unaware of the immense coral labyrinth beneath the surface.
Without warning, the vessel struck a sharp underwater reef, tearing open the wooden hull and leaving the crew stranded in dangerous tropical waters.
To lighten the damaged ship and prevent it from sinking, Cook ordered his men to heave heavy iron cannons and ballast overboard onto the seabed.
This desperate salvage operation allowed the Endeavour to refloat with the rising tide, leading to the first documented European survey of the Great Barrier Reef.

deepFeedback.independentSentence: Kalimat C adalah Kalimat Mandiri (Independent Sentence): Menyebutkan waktu spesifik ('In June 1770'), nama kapal dan kapten lengkap ('Captain James Cook', 'HMS Endeavour'), serta wilayah geografis tanpa kata ganti ambigu.
pairingClues: Pasangan 1 (C ➔ A): Kalimat C menjelaskan pelayaran Cook di sepanjang pesisir karang, dilanjutkan A yang menjelaskan kecelakaan tiba-tiba ('the vessel struck a sharp underwater reef').
Pasangan 2 (A ➔ D): Kerusakan lambung kapal di kalimat A memicu tindakan darurat Cook di kalimat D ('To lighten the damaged ship... Cook ordered his men to heave cannons overboard').
Pasangan 3 (D ➔ B): Pembuangan beban di D dirujuk secara anaforis oleh frasa 'This desperate salvage operation' di kalimat B sebagai hasil keberhasilan pengapungan kembali kapal.

items.title: The Commercial Evolution of Electric Vehicles

paragraphs.text: At the beginning of the twentieth century, electric automobiles competed fiercely with steam and gasoline carriages for supremacy on city streets.
However, the discovery of massive petroleum reserves in Texas rapidly drove down fuel prices and made gasoline vehicles far more economical.
Coupled with the invention of the electric self-starter, internal combustion engines soon dominated personal transportation for nearly a century.
Today, mounting concerns over carbon emissions and breakthrough lithium battery chemistries have reignited global demand for these zero-emission alternatives.

deepFeedback.independentSentence: Kalimat B adalah Kalimat Mandiri: Membuka kronologi historis ('At the beginning of the twentieth century') dan topik umum tentang mobil listrik awal tanpa transition markers.
pairingClues: Pasangan 1 (B ➔ D): Kalimat B memperkenalkan persaingan awal, dikontraskan oleh transisi 'However' di D yang menjelaskan jatuhnya harga minyak bumi.
Pasangan 2 (D ➔ A): Keunggulan ekonomi di D digabungkan ('Coupled with...') dengan penemuan self-starter di A yang mengunci dominasi mesin bensin.
Pasangan 3 (A ➔ C): Dominasi seabad di A dikontraskan dengan kebangkitan modern di C ('Today... zero-emission alternatives').

items.title: Coffee Cultivation and the Global Economy

paragraphs.text: Wild coffee plants originated in the forested highlands of southwestern Ethiopia, where nomadic pastoralists first consumed the energizing red berries.
By the fifteenth century, cultivation had crossed the Red Sea into Yemen, where Sufi monasteries pioneered the brewing of boiled beverage infusions.
From these Arabian ports, bustling trading networks swiftly carried the exotic roasted beans into the merchant capitals of Renaissance Europe.
The establishment of dedicated coffeehouses across London and Paris subsequently stimulated intellectual discourse and paved the way for modern financial exchanges.

deepFeedback.independentSentence: Kalimat D adalah Kalimat Mandiri: Memulai dari asal-usul geografis awal tanaman kopi ('Wild coffee plants originated in... Ethiopia') dengan subjek utuh tanpa pronomina.
pairingClues: Pasangan 1 (D ➔ B): Dari Ethiopia di D, jalur waktu bergerak ke abad ke-15 di B ('By the fifteenth century, cultivation had crossed the Red Sea into Yemen').
Pasangan 2 (B ➔ C): Wilayah Yaman di B dirujuk secara geografis oleh 'From these Arabian ports' di kalimat C.
Pasangan 3 (C ➔ A): Kedatangan biji kopi ke Eropa di C memicu berdirinya kedai kopi di A ('The establishment of dedicated coffeehouses across London and Paris...').
